subject.title: fix(security): exclude test files from plugin code-safety scans (#82469)

question: Should test-named files be excluded only from plugin `plugins.code_safety` scans, or also from installed-skill `skills.code_safety` scans?
rationale: The current patch decides a broader scan-coverage boundary than the plugin-focused issue requires, and that security boundary should not be inferred from a shared helper edit.

options.title: Limit exclusion to plugin scans
options.body: Thread the option through the helper and pass it only from `collectPluginsCodeSafetyFindings`, preserving current installed-skill coverage while fixing the reported plugin false positive.

options.title: Accept broader skill exclusion
options.body: Keep the shared-helper behavior only if maintainers explicitly accept that installed-skill test paths should be out of deep code-safety scope and require proof for that broader behavior.

options.title: Pause for audit-scope policy
options.body: Hold this PR until the canonical issue settles whether test-file exclusion, string masking, or another audit strategy should be the permanent fix.

recommendation.title: Limit exclusion to plugin scans
recommendation.body: Thread the option through the helper and pass it only from `collectPluginsCodeSafetyFindings`, preserving current installed-skill coverage while fixing the reported plugin false positive.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent security-audit hardening work is the strongest history signal for deciding this scan-scope boundary.
